_doc: Meta repo's own quality config (EVOL-040). complexity disabled (repo is markdown + small bash/python validators — Semgrep MCP coverage for .sh is weak; revisit if validators grow). code_review defaults (Block 20 active, dogfooding). security_scan resolved concrete: gitleaks is the meta repo's ratified scanner (RDR-2; house default, range-aware, single binary).

security_scan.install_hint: brew install gitleaks | apt: see github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases

budgets._doc: Injection budgets in BYTES per point (EVOL-043). One reader measures the REAL producer at its worst case: python3 scripts/gate.py budget. Raising a key needs its record in the changelog. prompt_submit ≥ snapshot + the reload wrapper + the stale warning (the worst case forces both).

coherence._doc: Coherence gates (EVOL-044). certifying_artefacts: the verdict artefacts gate.py currency judges (terminal status/verdict must carry certifies: from gate.py certify). Empty list = a ratified opt-out.

surface._doc: Per-PR surface ceiling (EVOL-045). The reviewable unit is bounded per pull request: python3 scripts/gate.py surface measures files + lines of the diff vs the one diff base (gate.py diff-base) with no exclusion list; over a ceiling blocks the push unless a commit trailer `Surface-Escape: <term>` names one of `escapes` (closed vocabulary — extending it needs a decision record). runtime_surface: globs a deployment can change — a train whose diff touches none owes no deployment ([] = every train deploys). Meta ceilings are wide: an evolution ships the template tree and its meta twin in one PR.
